name: Smart diff: Files changed tab groups files by role, shows findings inline, and can return to the original order
description: Open PR #482, switch to Files changed and confirm the Smart-order view: the five role groups in order, the seeded CRITICAL finding as an inline card with its 'blocker' label on src/config.ts, the off-patch N+1 finding in the end-of-file block, the boilerplate group collapsed until expanded, and the flat list after switching to Original order. Read-only seeded data; no Run Review, no Accept/Dismiss, no model call. Assumes a freshly seeded DB (see seed-fixtures.md).
